source.scope: Read-only source/immutable published preimages, primary API browsing and791B officialheader evidence only. Root current peer/deadline/runner/FinalUse WIP was not modified.

primary_API_sources.fact: Current Microsoft SDK source comment documents SIO_AF_UNIX_GETPEERPID output as an ULONG process identifier only. This establishes no returned TokenUser or connection-time access-token object.

raw_receipt.ref: main observed at read, not a pinned source release qualification
raw_receipt.api_fact: SIO_AF_UNIX_GETPEERPID comment says returns ULONG PID of connected peer process; no token credential return advertised by this definition

primary_API_sources.fact: Historical2017 implementation announcement says ancillary credentials/file-descriptor passing were unsupported. This historical note alone is not a proof about every futureWindows build.
The documented token-returning secure-socket query requires AF_INET or AF_INET6 and SOCK_STREAM/SOCK_DGRAM. It is not a documented AF_UNIX token-credential path.
Likewise requires AF_INET/AF_INET6 and blocking non-overlapped socket; user token may be unavailable and computer token fallback is documented. It cannot be assumed as AF_UNIX same-user proof.
Documented secure-socket extensions currently support IPsec, not a generic authenticated local AF_UNIX transport.

The server can acquire the security context of the last message read from that exact named-pipe instance. Return value must be checked; failure leaves server context active and must never authorize a request. SecurityIdentification is an allowed level.

Opens the thread token; OpenAsSelf permits querying an Identification token. Anonymous token cannot be opened. Querying this actual impersonated token is distinct from reopening a process by numericPID.
Must restore thread identity after impersonation; documented advice on failure is process shutdown because continuing in client context is unsafe.

Documents explicit security descriptor, FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE, overlapped operations, REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS and bounded maximum instances. Default descriptor grants Everyone/anonymous read; buffer sizes are advisory and do not by themselves constitute a physical-memory quota.

Kernel checks pipe DACL for clients and server instances. FILE_GENERIC_WRITE includes FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE; use precise role-specific rights rather than blindly inheriting resource or broad generic ACL. No recommendation here to add logon SID to restriction list.
Returns a process identifier, not the peer TokenUser snapshot.
Returns a process identifier; not a direct authenticated TokenUser credential API.

conclusions: The SDK exposes AF_UNIX peerPID. PID ->OpenProcess ->OpenProcessToken observes whichever process is successfully opened at that later time; the reviewed API contract does not bind that token to the exact socket connect-time security context. Rechecking the same numeric PID is still not a credential snapshot. Do not returnOk from ensure_current_user_peer based on that alone.

The reviewed Microsoft token-returning socket APIs explicitly apply to IPv4/IPv6 secure sockets, not this AF_UNIX adapter. No supported AF_UNIX TokenUser producer satisfying this contract was established in this review. This is not an impossibility claim for all future kernels/APIs.

Current Windows codex_uds peer gate and original unsupported test must remain exact. Current matrixd consumes it before frame decode; root Agentd WIP now consumes it before permit/overload traffic. These correct refusals cannot be removed or substituted by directory-exists/PID/user-suppliedSID checks.

The elevated runner helpers have a different narrow producer: parent creates randomized pipes, applies sandbox-user ACL and compares to its freshly spawned runner identity. Their guarantees must be reviewed with the held-child owner; they are not a generic incoming-client TokenUser factory for unrelated Agentd/matrixd callers.

IDE pipe client validates a server process token using a returned serverPID and limits SQOS to Identification. Its test reads a real message then impersonates and observes Identification, but that is test-source only, not an existing general production server peer identity issuer.

CapturedPrincipal and CapturedPrimaryOwner are resource-owning roles and intentionally reject Identification (and all impersonation for primary owner). They must not be loosened to make a peer-observation role pass; a future peer observation must be distinct, non-convertible and non-authorizing.

smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.transport: Explicit versioned Windows owner-local named-pipe transport consumed by both ends of existing ordinary control callers; preserve current AF_UNIX UnixStream API and unsupported test unchanged. Do not silently reinterpret old UnixStream as authenticated or replace its negative test fixture.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.producer: Actual server pipe instance with explicit owner-scoped noninherited security descriptor, remote clients rejected, first-instance collision refused, retained kernel handle and reviewed namespace/rendezvous binding. Exact endpoint identity must bind verified layout/owner/generation; no path string or metadata file alone grants authority.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.identity_step: Before any business JSON/overload response/effect, consume only a fixed bounded non-business authentication prelude on the same instance under the original total deadline. On one synchronous native thread and without await/callback, ImpersonateNamedPipeClient ->direct OpenThreadToken(TOKEN_QUERY,OpenAsSelf) with no process fallback ->bounded kernel TokenUser comparison to captured real server owner ->restore and revalidate original thread identity. Client must specify SQOS Identification, not default unrestricted impersonation; Anonymous/Unsupported/query errors refuse.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.typed_result: Fresh private peer-observation role constructed solely from exact live instance+real token result. No caller-supplied PID/SID/DTO constructor, Clone/Serde, no conversion to CapturedPrincipal/primary owner/FinalUse/model/resource grant. A successful historical identity observation does not authorize arbitrary protocol methods.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.scope_restore: No async continuation or business code may run impersonated. Revert failure must enter a reviewed fail-stop/unknown-owner path, not become an ordinaryErr returned to a reused Tokio worker. Error/drop/timeout/owner cancellation paths retain exact handles and prove terminal completion; cleanup must not be claimed from merely requestingCancelIoEx.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.actual_consumers: Versioned transport must wire MatrixdControlServer, real matrix supervisor/client on supported platforms, AgentdControlServer, AgentdClient and their live/stale/discovery cleanup. Located supervisor matrix control sender is in cfg(unix) module, so a Windows ordinary caller still needs a genuine producer+consumer implementation, not a new listener alone.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.resource_order: Authentication must remain inside original accepted-operation2s window and original32 admitted connection limit; no detached/unbounded preauth workers or an extra unaudited instance/queue allowance. Retain original per-poll deadline gate and overload50ms where that operation exists. The exact slot/accept ordering and instance count require design/native validation, not an inferred PASS.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.rendezvous: Keep caller-facing path/layout generation binding explicit. Pipe objects do not use NTFS stale socket deletion semantics; new ownertype must refuse collisions/foreign instances and retain qualified private discovery/namespace owner. Current create_dir_all/non-Unix ACL no-ops cannot supply it.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.mutual_scope: Named-pipe server impersonation authenticates its incoming client. It does not by itself authenticate the server to a client. Client connection must validate the independently protected endpoint/creator ownership and exact generation; if the contract requires mutual live token identity, add a reviewed genuine mutual authenticated transport rather than claiming PID lookup suffices. This outstanding decision prevents a narrow drop-in implementation here.
smallest_real_production_direction_not_i.why_no_mirror_source: No current generic producer satisfies same-instance token observation, protected rendezvous, bounded cancellation/restore and both ordinary callers. Writing a PID-onlyOk or an unconsumed newpeer factory would weaken the actual guard. This review therefore creates no source candidate.

existing_primitives_reuse_limits.CurrentUser: Existing bounded TokenUser parser can be reused inside a new distinct module only with an actual impersonated thread token; generic open_effective_token ERROR_NO_TOKEN fallback must not be accepted as successfulpeer proof.
existing_primitives_reuse_limits.CapturedPrincipal: Use only to retain/revalidate the actual server resource context before/after peer inspection; never use it as peer credential or lower its impersonation policy.
existing_primitives_reuse_limits.ParentAnchor: Existing NTFS parent owner is a create-only disk namespace proof; it is not authority over\.\pipe namespace or arbitrary pipe handles.
existing_primitives_reuse_limits.ProtectedDescriptor: Currently includes file/resource full rights; new pipe-specific ACL must be reviewed against FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE overlap, not copied as a proof of pipe safety.
existing_primitives_reuse_limits.runner_pipe: Preserve root runner ownership work and its exact role. Its name/PID inputs cannot be relabeled as current-user authenticated local IPC.

required_future_native_evidence_NOT_RUN: Original AF_UNIX unsupported test unchanged; genuine named-pipe same-user success and distinct-user failure using independently owned real Windows tokens, no synthetic SID or peer DTO.

Anonymous/Identification SQOS behavior, failed impersonation/query/restore, peer exit/PID reuse, handle duplication/inheritance/transfer, replacement or foreign first instance, spoofed endpoint metadata/generation and mismatched owner must refuse without business effects.
Actual Windows ordinary Agentd+matrixd clients and servers consume the new peer result, not only a native helper fixture. No fakeprivate ctor/prepared/fullguard.

All auth/read/write/cancel/reap/cleanup under original2s, original32 limit/frame bounds and original Nice10/resource assertions where applicable. No named-pipe advisory buffer size used as physical quota proof.
Retain all broad-identity-delete/legacy refusal and unknown terminal failures; this transport stage cannot qualify token isolation/PE-DLL/desktop/stdio/Job/model/installation.
